english.title: Refuse/fail to permit Environment Agency to inspect and take copies of records of water flow, level etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, refused or failed to permit the Environment Agency to exercise its right under section 197(3) of the Water Resources Act 1991 to

(A)_[inspect]_
(B)_[take copies of, or extracts from]_

the contents of records of the flow, level or volume of inland waters, other than discrete waters kept by a person other than a water undertaker
english.legislation: Contrary to section 197(3) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
